entry.title: How Encrisoft Achieved 20x Speedup Without More Hardware
entry.summary:
Introduction
As the founder of Encrisoft, I am incredibly proud of Alerta, our customizable instant alerting API that has already processed over 80 million alerts for businesses. But here’s the thing about growth: it’s a double-edged sword. More alerts means more value for customers, but it also means more pressure on the system. Over time, we started noticing signs of strain: Dashboards that once loaded instantly began to lag. Queries that were lightning-fast slowed to a crawl. Uptime felt fragile because the database was under stress. This article is a technical deep-dive into how we fixed that. You’ll see exactly how we: Optimised PostgreSQL with the right indexes. Introduced Redis caching (the smart way). Achieved a 20× speedup without adding a single new server. And most importantly…
